item.title: Trail Tater Campfire RSS Test — New Template Check
item.description: This is a Trail Tater Campfire test update. We are checking that the new Brevo RSS email template pulls the title, date, description, image, and Read More link correctly. If this arrives looking like Trail Tater instead of the old stock template, the campfire is officially lit.
